name: Tanaka Yubiseiharukana
original_name: 田中 優美清春香菜
source:
A freshman at Kyumeikan Women's University intending to major in archeology, and a part-time worker at LeMU. Her father gave her this unique first name because Tanaka was a common surname but very rare as a first name. She also possesses a wealth of occult-related knowledge and skills to survive in an emergency. More than anything, she loves to talk. Her nickname is "You."

[From [url=http://www.gamefaqs.com/pc/931349-ever-17-out-of-infinity/faqs/43865]Walkthrough by Denethor0[/url]]

[spoiler]She is the young "Tanaka You" in 2017 LeMU incident and the grown-up "Dr. Tanaka" in the 2034 LeMU incident. By 2034, she is 35 years old but physically 23 years old, and she is pretending to be her own mother, "Tanaka Yukie."[/spoiler]
